about: MontClip's own words for Cindy keys whose Cindy wording does not fit MontClip, laid over cindy-strings.json. The four permission modes are MontClip's, in 助手面板 v7.2 §3 words (#83's, with their full stops; the same sentences as the mode tips and the Yolo bar, test/cindy-parts.test.js); the stand-in useAgentCapabilities gives them under Cindy's ids plan / ask / auto / bypassPermissions.

ask.label: 手动
ask.description: 改项目前先问你；撤不回的每次都问。默认是这个。

auto.label: 自动
auto.description: 能撤销的直接做，撤不回的先问你。

bypassPermissions.label: Yolo
bypassPermissions.description: 每一步都直接做，不问你；往外发的内容照样先给你看。

ask.label: Manual
ask.description: Asks before changing the project; asks every time for anything that can't be undone. This is the default.

auto.label: Auto
auto.description: Does what can be undone; asks before what can't.

bypassPermissions.label: Yolo
bypassPermissions.description: Does every step without asking you; anything sent out is still shown to you first.
